reviews.text: The staff has been warm and welcoming and helpful!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but after being a loyal customer for years, I feel compelled to share my experience in the hope that it helps other pet owners.

I have been bringing my dog to this clinic since he was about 8 months old, and unfortunately, the quality of service has declined significantly over the years.

On July 9, I brought my dog in for allergy treatment. I spent over $300 on the visit, including allergy injections, yet his condition showed little to no improvement. At checkout, I was told to bring him back for a follow-up within 14 days. My invoice clearly showed the follow-up exam fee as $0. However, when I called to schedule the follow-up, I was told I would have to pay $65. When I questioned why the invoice listed the fee as $0, no one could provide a reasonable explanation. It felt like the clinic was making up policies as they went along.

Another frustrating issue was the inconsistency in how appointments are handled. During my last visit, I was suddenly told that my dog would be taken to the back and examined there instead of in the exam room with me present. I explained that this had never been their normal process during the many years I've been coming here. I even showed photos from previous visits where the veterinarian examined my dog in the exam room. I had to argue my case because they initially wanted to charge me for a doctor examination while only having a technician take my dog to the back, allegedly because they were running behind schedule.

The lack of consistency, poor communication, and unexpected charges have completely eroded my trust in this clinic. As pet owners, we rely on honesty, transparency, and compassionate care. Unfortunately, I no longer feel confident that this clinic provides those things.

After many years as a customer, I will be taking my dog elsewhere. I hope the clinic takes these concerns seriously because pets deserve better, and so do the families who trust them with their care.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET TO THIS CLINIC. I've brought my dog here multiple times, and every visit has been disappointing. The customer service is terrible, the front desk staff are rude and unprofessional, and they make you feel like you're an inconvenience rather than a paying customer.

Despite spending a lot of money on appointments and medications, my dog never seemed to improve. It felt like they were more interested in charging for treatments than actually helping my pet. On top of that, you're left waiting at least 45 minutes for the veterinarian, even with an appointment.

Looking through their reviews, it seems many other pet owners have had similar experiences. Based on mine. Save your money and take your pet somewhere that genuinely cares about animals and treats customers with respect.

My husband has been going to them for 7 years - they’re not online / not automated however what we really don’t like is they’re not clean, hair all over the assistant’s uniform, they lack transparency (cannot go in with your pet while they administer treatment or vaccine) and last visit in 2025, were told to do a certain unnecessary procedure (happened only once and could’ve been a fluke but made us very unhappy about their concern for pets) - luckily my husband checked our records and confirmed it was unnecessary. No apologies at all.

Pet Vet Animal Hospital stays true to old school, traditional American values — this is a place that will smile while completely avoiding accountability & speak in technical lingo to confuse you. They will be intentionally vague about the pick-up time & estimate in an attempt to overcharge. They have certain workers at the front and certain workers kept in the back.

As a UCD alumni I was initially ecstatic to find a vet I thought I could trust but I was gravely mistaken.

Although they present a good face, if pointed out for a mistake Dr Wood will laugh, smile and try to charm her way out of it & lie or create loopholes to avoid taking accountability.  I was genuinely disturbed by the behavior I observed with the staff when I went in during closing hours. It was a complete switch from their daytime act. I do not blame the individuals but their management & training process. I highly recommend finding another place for your pet. If something goes wrong you will be screwed.

In response: A desperate attempt to save the business. Yes I’m unhappy as I stated financial difficulty yet was taken advantage of and overcharged with a smile — I was given less than 30 minutes to pick my pet up, threatened to be charged by the minute until morning because I signed a piece of paper. I’m sure those getting taken advantage of are unaware as they trust the vets. With the current state of this world it’s more of a reason to not push someone’s buttons and try to take advantage. I had already paid the bill! No reason to argue with someone after that. Taking accountability is a big part of ethics.

Put simply, this place will ramp up their charm while providing service but turn into straight thugs when it comes to the money part. You’ve been warned
Thank you to everyone at PetCure Veterinary for the care and kindness you showed us. And a special thank you for taking such great care of my dog — it truly means more than words can say.

I'm writing this review in support of Dr. Cheryl Wood. Someone who described herself as a fellow alumnus of UCD left a nasty and undeserved review attacking Dr. Woods' character, very unfairly. For the record, Dr. Cheryl Wood is a kind, patient, caring professional. She saw both of my cats for over a year here where I live in Orange County, CA. I am so sorry to see her maligned by a nasty, critical patron. Dr. Wood got my two cats on a prescription renal diet at a crucial juncture, enabling them to stabilize. She explained that diet is more important than fluids at early stages of CKD, and if I got them on a low protein, phosphorous controlled food they liked, they could live longer and happier lives, which is exactly what they are doing over one year later. I credit her with my male cat's kidney improvement. He went from a creatinine of 1.9 down to 1.4 under her care. I know that kidneys don't repair themselves, but whatever is remainining of his kidneys are actually functioning better now. I love Dr. Wood! I hope that the rude customer who maligned her will stop trying to ruin other people's reputations. Maybe she is just a very unhappy person.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Beyond Grateful for Pet Vet Animal Hospital in Winnetka/canoga park on sherman way.
— They Are Truly Angels

I don’t even know where to begin expressing my gratitude for everyone at Pet Vet Animal Hospital, on sherman way in winnetka/canoga park— from the front office to the back, Angie, Miguel, Dr. Gueta, Dr Lital-Kirszenbaum and any/all others whose name i might have omitted.
This vetrinarian office literally gives new meaning to what i have experienced in the past. A team truly dedicated in their profession and who love what they do.... and it so shows.
All seriously have been a blessing beyond words to both me and my sweet dog Chilita, who is battling congestive heart failure. This dog is more than my whole world and to have found this group leaves me  speechless and I just want to share with anyone looking for a vet that they are highly recommended. I mean, let's face it, we know the cost for caring for an animal can become costly. PETVETs charges are fair and competitive. . So at least if you go there , you are getting a full spectrum of service that goes beyond.

The care, compassion, and love they have shown us have been nothing short of extraordinary. They have done everything possible to make sure Chilita is comfortable and getting the best care. They don’t just treat your pet — they truly care, with empathy, professionalism, and genuine love as if your dog were their own.

In my 62 years, I have never found a veterinary team that embodies everything you could hope for — until now. Pet Vet is the real deal: skilled, kind, and deeply human. I will forever be grateful to them for helping us through such a difficult time with compassion and heart.

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart. ❤️

— Laura & Chilita

Horrible place! Made an appointment for my 14 year-old German Shepherd and because I was 15 minutes late the office manager told me to get out. I explained that it is 120 pound dog that has nerve damage and is not able to walk so it’s very difficult to put him in and out of the car and he needed to be seen urgently. She said because you’re late for your appointment. You cannot be here we have other patients. She made me put this old dog back in the car and didn’t even schedule me another appointment. What a heartless monster.
Their phone line is down, kept calling over and over and after the machine says this call is being recorded for quality assurance I get a busy signal. So had to call another Vet
Great doctors. Extremely high prices!!! Wait time is excruciating. Never going back.

Thieves and con artists.  Went in for basic shots ($90) and left with a manufactured ear infection ($800+). I asked them which ear they treated and they said "both, for balance". I took my dog to another vet who found no sign of infection.  They refused to acknowledge the "mistake" and take responsibility. It's a chain operation now charging the highest prices possible for doing nothing -- or for making stuff up.  AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS.

Pet Vet is fantastic. Dr. Kirszenbaum is warm, caring, and always takes the time to make you and your pet feel comfortable. Jonathan, the first voice you’ll hear on the phone, is endlessly patient and helpful, never rushed, always kind.

But the real star is Miguel, the vet tech extraordinaire. He’s a wealth of knowledge, incredibly kind, and brings a calming, gentle presence to every visit. Like a big teddy bear, he makes both pets and people feel safe and cared for.

This team goes above and beyond - highly recommend! 4/5 stars only because of their pricing.

It’s April 17 , 9:33 am and I’ve been waiting 30 minutes outside the vet . I’ve called & left voicemails asking when will they be open . I’ve read the signs and they have no notice saying they’ll be closed today . This is very unprofessional , as a first time customer I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone who needs any type of assistance , care for their pet.

You're in good hands with Miguel. He's got you!

Anji is professional, prompt, and pleasant.
Angie and Miguel are absolute angels, they are very skilled in all they do and are incredibly sweet. I cannot thank the doctors enough.
Miguel was a great nurse, and they were able to take kitty right away for tooth extraction surgery. Have been going there and highly recommend!
The cost was more than emergency hospital, I brought animals to before. Time will tell if the cost is good or bad.
Constantly running late, expect to wait for at least 45 minutes in the waiting room after your scheduled visit time before they even see your pet.

I've been coming to Pet Vet for nearly 12 years now - going back to when Dr. Beeter was there.  I see many are commenting on overpricing, and while I agree the prices have gone up - I have had a great experience with the staff (especially Marianna - front desk, sorry if I misspelled your name).  And, our dog's Vet has been amazing too.  Look guys - everywhere is expensive nowadays.  Yes, you may find a cheaper Vet and kudos to you if they take great care of your pet - like Pet Vet does!!  It's all about the comfort level we have w/ Pet Vet.  They have always taken good car of my dog, Yogi, especially recently when he had a major infection that required surgery.  Speaking of surgery, had we taken Yogi to have this surgery at another Emergency Vet Hospital, the cost would have been double.  5 stars all around!!

So grateful for Dr K ,Marianna and the rest of the staff at Pet Vet .Dr K is amazing and has such a kind heart and always listens to my concerns. I know my Mabel is always in good and  caring hands with her . Marianna is truly a gem , with such a kind and caring heart and such an important part of the practice as well. She is always available to help and hear your concerns /questions and does her very best to address them as fast as she can .
Grateful to these amazing ladies for all of their love and care !!!!
Xoxo Robyn (Mabel’s proud mommy)
Every person that we dealt with was very kind and helpful

Another update:

Dr. k and all the staff at Pet Vet continue to be lovely. They care so much …
All about the money 💰. Using the shock method to clients. Proclaim to know what is happening with my pet even though they did not receive test results yet, will be even more money then. …

Another place that try to take your money in any way they can!
Stay away …
I have to say props to Marianna who has A+ Customer service. She made sure I got all the documents for my pup and very helpful and on top of it even after all the multiple calls I had to make.
